groups.checks: character mapping, repeated spans, multispan coverage, quote and namespace rejection
groups.limit: Known paragraph boundaries and whitespace line splits; no automatic OCR/dehyphenation proof.

groups.checks: all alternatives retained; invisible unit excluded; untouched character provenance
groups.limit: Text/Sequence/Choice only; no field parser, amendment precedence or reference resolver.

groups.checks: every Boolean function through three variables, all partial observations, negation, conflict, reading/contingency quantifiers
groups.limit: Formal predicate correctness conditional on reviewed translation; production limit is twelve facts.

groups.checks: future validity, exclusive end, later knowledge, explicit false premise, conflict, missing source, malformed interval
groups.limit: Source identity is not authority; applicable law and completeness still need legal review.

groups.checks: per legal holder floor, exact residual conservation, strict shape/currency
groups.limit: Residual is an arithmetic value, not a claim that the contract requires cash compensation.

groups.checks: same result as direct calculation, reuse, task/environment changes, descendant invalidation, corruption, cycles
groups.limit: Static complete declared dependencies and pure tasks; no sandboxed discovery or durable receipt transaction implemented.

groups.checks: required phase products, every context field, content binding, exact obligation identities, UNKNOWN retained
groups.limit: Identity mapping only. Different question dates need a separately reviewed, versioned transformation.

groups.checks: disjoint implementer/readers/adjudicator, scope subset, cohort/report bound signoff
groups.limit: Logical identities only; cannot establish competence, actual blinding, independence, label quality or future accuracy.

claim: Small-model engineering checks, not independent legal validation
